game.name: RG-SMP
game.desc: An 11-track sample drum machine for your handheld: recursive WAV browser, per-track sample assignment, 1-16-step patterns with accents, swing and ratchets, a 200-slot pattern library, 512-bar song chains with WAV export, master effects, mute and punch-in FX. 1.1 adds USB-MIDI sync, per-track pitch and pattern-wide sample start/end cuts.
